recommendation.alert: Repair lab - recommendation errors or latency
recommendation.description: More than 20% failed or slower-than-1-second server requests over five minutes, sustained evaluation. Isolated lab.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
WITH {{.end_datetime}} AS evaluation_end,
payment_spans AS (
  SELECT timestamp, (has_error OR duration_nano >= 1000000000 OR traceID GLOBAL IN (SELECT traceID FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= evaluation_end - INTERVAL 7 MINUTE AND timestamp < evaluation_end AND serviceName = 'recommendation-repair-lab' AND kind = 1 AND has_error)) AS has_error
  FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp >= evaluation_end - INTERVAL 7 MINUTE
    AND timestamp < evaluation_end
    AND serviceName = 'recommendation-repair-lab'
    AND kind = 2
    AND resources_string['service.namespace'] = 'self-heal-repair-lab'
)
SELECT evaluation_end - toIntervalMinute(number) AS ts,
  toFloat64(if(
    countIf(timestamp >= ts - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND timestamp < ts) >= 5,
    100.0 * countIf(has_error AND timestamp >= ts - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND timestamp < ts)
      / greatest(countIf(timestamp >= ts - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND timestamp < ts), 1),
    0
  )) AS value
FROM numbers(3) AS evaluation_points
LEFT JOIN payment_spans ON 1 = 1
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

payment.alert: Repair lab - Payment Charge code failure
payment.description: Isolated code-defect experiment. Same >20% /5m minimum5 sustained2m rule as main demo; separate service and namespace.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
WITH {{.end_datetime}} AS evaluation_end,
payment_spans AS (
  SELECT timestamp, has_error
  FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp >= evaluation_end - INTERVAL 7 MINUTE
    AND timestamp < evaluation_end
    AND serviceName = 'payment-repair-lab'
    AND name = 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge'
    AND kind = 2
    AND resources_string['service.namespace'] = 'self-heal-repair-lab'
)
SELECT evaluation_end - toIntervalMinute(number) AS ts,
  toFloat64(if(
    countIf(timestamp >= ts - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND timestamp < ts) >= 5,
    100.0 * countIf(has_error AND timestamp >= ts - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND timestamp < ts)
      / greatest(countIf(timestamp >= ts - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND timestamp < ts), 1),
    0
  )) AS value
FROM numbers(3) AS evaluation_points
LEFT JOIN payment_spans ON 1 = 1
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
